meaning: The machine filled twice after a power failure: float switch stuck or failed, or clogged drain or sump.
diySteps: Tap on the float cover to un-stick the float (the plastic cover that looks like an upside-down cup in the front left corner of the tub floor)
Check the sump area at the back bottom of the tub for debris (it looks like an upside-down silverware basket and can become clogged)
safetyNote: Switch the dishwasher off at its breaker before you reach into the base or remove a filter or cover, and let the tub and water cool after a cycle. Watch for sharp debris. Pump, heater, valve and control-board repairs belong to a qualified appliance technician.
proAdvice: If the problem persists, contact GE service.
